rule_text: Prefer quantified limits over qualitative language for objective compliance assessment.

variants: Prefer measurable leak rate limits over absolute prevention claims.
Prefer measurable parameters over vague terms; 'any particulates' is unverifiable.
Prefer quantified limits over qualitative language for objective compliance assessment.
Prefer quantified limits over vague exclusions; enables verification and acceptance criteria.

rule_text: Prefer active voice 'shall move' over passive 'shall be able to move' construction.

variants: Prefer active voice 'shall move' over passive 'shall be able to move' construction.
Prefer active voice 'shall move' over passive construction 'shall be able to move'.

rule_text: Prefer quantified limits over vague negatives like 'not contribute any'.

variants: Flag vague absolutes: 'not contribute any' lacks measurable thresholds or units.
Flag vague terms like 'prevent' and 'leaking' without quantified acceptance criteria.
Prefer quantified limits over vague negatives like 'not contribute any'.

rule_text: Do not replace concise language with longer, more complex alternative phrasings.

variants: Do not introduce unnecessary complexity when simpler wording suffices.
Do not replace concise language with longer, more complex alternative phrasings.

rule_text: Flag modal weakness allowing non-performance; prefer direct obligation without capability hedging

variants: Flag modal weakness allowing non-performance; prefer direct obligation without capability hedging
Flag modal weakness; 'able to' expresses capability, not requirement; use 'shall' instead.
